newsitem.title: UGANDA: Uganda sells $4.9 million of 91 day T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Uganda sells $4.9 million of 91 day T-bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Uganda on Thursday said it sold 5.0 billion Ugandan shillings ($4.9 million) of the 91-day main category of treasury bills at weekly auction.

The bank said it sold 4.9232 billion shillings on a competitive basis and 0.0768 billion shillings on a non-competitive basis at an annualised yield of 9.867 percent -- an increase of 0.008 percent from last week.
Last week the bank sold 3.0 billion shillings of 91-day bills at an annualised yield of 9.859 percent
The price range was restored from last week's low of 57.570 - 57.513 to 97.570 - 97.485. Bank officials attributed last week's lows to the low interest rates quoted by buyers.

Due to increased demand for treasury bills, the bank invited tenders of 8.0 billion shillings of 91-day treasury bills for next week's auction on Wednesday. This is the highest amount invited for tender since the beginning of the year.
